pages.text: Sea Bears are all too real. All the things you shouldn't do if you want to keep sea bears away are:
First off, don't play the clarinet.$(br)$(br)Never wear a Sombrero IN A GOOFY FASHION.$(br)$(br)Or clown shoes, or a hoop skirt.$(br)$(br)And never, ever, ever, screech like a chimpanzee!
If you know a sea bear is certain to come and eat you, draw an Anti-Sea Bear Circle in the sand with a stick. All the experts say its the only defense against a Sea Bear attack.
